When a cynical veteran detective and his idealistic new partner are assigned to a gruesome homicide, they quickly realize they are hunting a methodical serial killer obsessed with the seven deadly sins. As each horrific crime scene mirrors a different transgression, the duo is dragged into a chilling psychological game of cat and mouse across a rain-drenched, decaying city. With time running out before the final two sins are executed, the detectives must confront their own inner demons to unravel the mastermind's twisted moral crusade.
